posts.title: tiny notebook musings iv
posts.description: • • thirteen • • I keep waiting for something that will change my life. It’s true that it needs to be me. I should be more present & rooted in my everyday. I'm so afraid of the future that l refuse to commit to anything, even in the here & now. I know I can’t go on like this. posts.title: half awake
posts.description: I don't know what I want to say. Something profound, of course, though I'm not much good at that. I just want to feel real again. I listen to the morning birds. I try to take note of the funny, flowered sprouts in my too-long grass. It's all sideways. I sleep poorly for weeks, sleep too deeply for weeks. posts.title: strange light
posts.description: I find it in odd places: fractals of rain, a pond I pass by in the morning, the window of a house, the curve of the glass. Same light, though. Strange light. A noticing light, perhaps; it is the light that I notice.
